quandoUsar: Group a title, short description, media, and one or two actions about the same object (a project, an itinerary, an article) in a grid or list.
A summary that opens a larger quick look without leaving the page: with `details`, the whole card becomes the trigger and grows into a central panel.
A footer with the owner and a state that changes in place, such as “Updated just now”, announced to the screen reader.
quandoEvitar: Use `expandable-card` when the extra content should open in place, within the page flow, and not in a dialog.
Use `metric-card` for a number with context and change.
Use `dialog` for decisions and forms that do not start from a card: the quick look here is for reading more about the same item.

teclado.acao: With `details`, stops on the title, which becomes a button; focus appears as a stronger card border.
Open the quick look from the title.
Closes the quick look: the panel returns to the card's place and focus returns to the title.
With the quick look open, cycle only among the panel's controls.

acessibilidade: The card is an `article` with an `h3` title; the quick look is a Radix modal dialog (traps focus, closes with `Esc` or outside click, and returns focus) with the title as `h2` and the description linked by `aria-describedby`.
With `details`, the title's click area covers the whole card and `action` sits on top; the title button has no outline of its own, only the card border changes on focus.
`status` is a `role="status"` region, so each new text is announced; the close button has an English label (“Close quick look”), and the media `alt` is up to you.
movimento: Under the mouse pointer the card rises 2 px with a shadow and the media slowly zooms in to 4%.

In the quick look, the surface, photo, title, description, and footer travel on a no-overshoot spring from the card to the central panel and return along the same path on closing; `details` enters after the panel has grown.
With “reduce motion”, the card neither rises nor zooms the photo, the quick look only fades, and `status` swaps without animation.
responsivo: The quick look panel is `min(100vw - var(--space-8), 30rem)` wide and at most the screen height minus the same margin, with internal scrolling.
The card takes the parent's width; in a narrow footer, `meta` and `status` truncate with an ellipsis instead of going under `action`.
desempenho: Each card with `details` mounts its own dialog and a size observer, and the quick look backdrop uses `backdrop-filter`; in long grids, pass `details` only where it is needed.
notasIA: `title` is required and is text; `media`, `avatar`, `meta`, `action`, `children`, and `details` are free slots, and `status` must be a string because it animates word by word.
`open`, `defaultOpen`, and `onOpenChange` only apply with `details`; without it the card is static and the title does not become a button.
With the quick look open, `media`, `children`, `avatar`, and `action` exist twice (in the card and in the panel): do not put a fixed `id` or local state inside them.
